title: Andhere Andhre yateemo se chupkar
body:
Zehra... zehra.. zehra... zehra...
<<MINI>>
Andhere andhere yateemo se chup kar
sare qabr e zehra ali ro rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ya zehra, ya zehra
1. Tumhari musibat bhulaunga kaise
mai bachho se aasu chupaunga kaise
tumhe yaad karke jo royenge bachhe
<<DIVIDER>>
mai bachho ko apne manaunga kaise
tasawwur mein zehra se karke ye baatein
jhukaye sar apna ali ro rahe hai
2. Ya zehra, ya zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi aasuo'n ko chupati hai zainab
kabhi bhaiyo ko uthati hai zainab
kabhi ghar ke aangan mein aati hai zainab
kabhi maa ke hujre mein jaati hai zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi roke dukhiya ye karti hai nauha
utho amma fizza ali ro rahe hai
3. Ya zehra, ya zehra
Utho shahzadi hua hai andhera
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhare bina wo kaha'n so sakega
mai jaunga wapas to bolega baba
meri maa kaha'n hai bula do khudara
akele jalakar charagh aasuo'n ka
<<MINI>>
sare qabr e zehra ali ro rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Ya zehra, ya zehra
Hai shehre nabi mein samaa karbala ka
na koi tasalli na koi dilasa
taraste hai ghar mein yatiman e zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
koi aake deta nahi inko pursa
hussain o hasan ka kahi'n par hai girya
kahi'n mere maula ali ro rahe hai
5. Ya zehra, ya zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi is jagah ko na bhulenge maula
ye kucha hai maqtal dil e murtaza ka
yaha'n se na guzre hasan baad e zehra
sitamgar ne maara tha yu taziyana
<<DIVIDER>>
Mohammad ki beti zamee'n par giri thi
yaha'n baithe tanha ali ro rahe hai
6. Ya zehra, ya zehra
Wo lamhe hai mushkil ali ko bhulana
<<DIVIDER>>
wo pehlu pe jalte hue darr ka girna
wo aaho'n ka bharna wo zakhmo ka ghisna
shahadat wo mohsin ki zehra ka rona
takallum abhi tak isi bekasi par
<<DIVIDER>>
lahad mein bhi maula ali ro rahe hai
<<MINI>>
Andhere andhere yateemo se chup kar
sare qabr e zehra ali ro rahe hai..(3)
